name: The Buddhist Sutras
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from the Pali canon and classical translations (after Wong Mou-lam, 1930; the Sacred Books of the Buddhists)
note: Beyond the Dhammapada: the perfection-of-wisdom Heart Sutra, the great Lotus Sutra, the Buddha's teachings on loving-kindness and free inquiry, Shantideva's Way of the Bodhisattva, the Zen Platform Sutra, and the verses of the earliest Buddhist nuns.
